goal: Keep both exact-head reviewer slots independent in either draw order, recover a conflicting unstarted replacement without disturbing an approved peer, and refuse duplicate-provider merge evidence
prohibited_actions: No database write, migration edit, manual production command, or shared main merge
Do not alter the existing PR3426 review assignments, verdicts, or replacement refs
Do not discard any existing reviewer approval to repair a slot conflict
assumptions: The two review slots are required to have distinct providers on one exact head
A conflicting slot may be replaced only before a verdict, artifact, or run-start marker exists
The peer slot approval remains immutable during conflict recovery
This contract is published before the final implementation and evidence commits; an earlier implementation commit already exists on the branch
stop_conditions: Refuse a replacement when either peer assignment cannot be read or the exact conflict cannot be proved
Refuse a recovery that would return a peer slot verdict or release a different lease
Refuse merge proof when two latest reviewer slots name the same provider
